title: Winter Spiti Circuit
summary: A slow winter crossing of high villages, frozen rivers, and monastery kitchens that still cook on wood.
description: Winter Spiti is quiet in the way cities never are. The circuit rolls from Shimla toward Kaza while the valley turns bone-white, with time built in for altitude, chai, and the long light on Key Monastery. Groups stay small so the vehicle can stop when the landscape asks for it.

title: Meghalaya Living Bridges

title: Kedarnath Dawn Walk
summary: A paced pilgrimage with pony-free walking days, warm stays, and no midnight rush to the temple.
description: Kedarnath deserves an unhurried approach. This departure walks the trail in daylight, sleeps well below the shrine the night before, and reaches the temple when the mountains are still quiet. It suits pilgrims and first-time Himalayan walkers equally.
highlights: Temple darshan without the night rush
